title: 1985 AMC 8 Problem 4
statement: The area of polygon \(ABCDEF,\) in square units, is

solutions.text:
Completing the figure to the full \(6 \times 9\) rectangle gives an area of \(54.\) The piece removed from the lower-left corner is a rectangle measuring \(2\) by \(4,\) with area \(8.\)

So the polygon’s area is \(54 - 8 = 46.\)

Thus, the correct answer is C .
hints: Extend sides \(AF\) and \(DC\) to complete a full \(6 \times 9\) rectangle
